headline: Fund usability first: ad load and the redesign are the best-supported, most reliably labelled specific problems, with the paywall and playback as caveated alternatives

recommendations.rationale: USA-ADS is the second-highest actionable issue by priority score and had strong label agreement in the blind audit.
recommendations.title: Reduce ad intrusiveness

recommendations.rationale: USA-REDESIGN complaints centre on layout changes and missing basics such as repeat, rewind and like.
recommendations.title: Restore basic controls removed by the redesign

recommendations.rationale: BIL-PAYWALL has the top actionable priority score, but the verifier often relabelled it as usability, so it should be coordinated with the ads work.
recommendations.title: Review paywall and ad friction jointly

recommendations.rationale: Playback severity is high but its topic labels had weak verifier agreement, so ownership should be confirmed first.
recommendations.title: Re-label playback complaints before funding them
